h:
V3 让一切变得更好。

Morcellini Workflow Krea 2 V1 具有 Pid 4k 升级、面部和身体细节、LLM，可增强您的提示和专业级后期处理。它基于 Lonecat 的出色工作流程

https://civitai.com/models/2696674/ideogram4-pro-grade-workflow-w-vram-optimizers

V2 仍然具有 Lonecat 出色的后处理套件，但它是为了更好地与 Krea 2 配合使用而设计的。我使 V2 变得更简单，以便任何人都可以从中学习一些东西。

o.en:
V3 just made everything better.

Morcellini Workflow Krea 2 V1 has Pid 4k upscaling, face and body detailers, LLM to enhance your prompts and pro level post processing. It's based on a great workflow by Lonecat

https://civitai.com/models/2696674/ideogram4-pro-grade-workflow-w-vram-optimizers

The V2 has still the great post processing suite by Lonecat but it's made to better work with Krea 2. I made the V2 a bit simpler so that anyone can learn a little bit from it.
